Metadata.description: Staffing simulator for consultancies: build a project team, see cost and margin live.

Home.tagline: Build a project team and see cost and margin before you commit.
Home.demoNote: Every name and figure is made up. Your changes are saved to a copy only you can see.

NotFound.title: We couldn't find this page
NotFound.description: The address may be wrong, or the page may no longer exist.

choose.title: Choose “{name}”?
choose.description: Today's rates of its categories, overhead, buffer and availability are frozen; the price, extra costs and target margin are not. Its team can no longer be edited until you unchoose the scenario.
choose.replaces: “{name}” will no longer be the project's chosen scenario: its frozen values are discarded and its team can be edited again.
choose.missingRate: {categories} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} no rate, so there is nothing to freeze.

unchoose.title: Unchoose “{name}”?
unchoose.description: Its frozen rates and cost config are discarded: the scenario is costed with the current values again, and its team can be edited.

waiting.unsaved: The changes are not saved yet: you can go on as soon as they are.

waiting.stopped: This page can no longer save changes: reload it to go on.

refused.failed: The choice could not be saved. Try again.

Bench.title: Bench
Bench.occupancyNote: Occupancy on {day}, from the scenarios chosen in Squadio. It is not availability during the project.

ScenarioError.title: We couldn't open this scenario
ScenarioError.description: Something went wrong while reading it. Try again in a moment.

TeamTree.label: Team tree
TeamTree.instructions: Move with the arrow keys: up to the manager, down to the first report, left and right between colleagues. Home goes back to the root. Plus, minus and zero zoom in, zoom out and fit the view.
TeamTree.missingRateDetail: Its category has no rate, so the scenario has no cost.

empty.title: This scenario has no team yet

layoutError.title: We can't draw this team
layoutError.unknownReportsTo: {name} reports to an assignment that is not in this scenario.
layoutError.cycle: These assignments report to each other in a loop: {names}.

TeamTable.label: Team table
TeamTable.instructions: Move with the arrow keys: up and down between rows, right to expand a row or enter its cells, left to collapse a row or go to its manager. Home and End go to the first and last row, or to the first and last cell.
